feedback.problem: Find the Cartesian coordinates of the point where the polar curve $r=7$ intersects the positive $y$-axis.
feedback.worked_solution:
The polar curve $r=7$ is a circle of radius $7$ centered at the origin. It crosses the positive $y$-axis at the point $(0,7),$ as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13959689/assets/cf8bdc8c72bbc86361dd9378575d8daa10d775132c909b88a77ee185e57fe116.png)

Therefore, the point of intersection is $(0,7).$
